item.title: Spring Hokubu region treasure hunt location in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: The summer Tokyo City region treasure hunt is one of the weekly activities in Forza Horizon 6 Series 7, "City Life." Whenever a new hunt begins, a box appears somewhere on the map and, to locate it, the only hints you have are the region's name and a picture. Completing this challenge helps you get closer to claiming the weekly and the Series cars.

item.title: All active Escape From Tarkov codes and rewards
item.description: Escape From Tarkov promo codes are used in the classic extraction shooter for all sorts of rewards. From in-game gear and weapons to currency, cosmetics, and more, redeeming as many of these Tarkov codes as you can will set you up for your next raid. Especially since these goodies don't actually require a successful extraction to obtain them.

item.title: Andy Weir's New Sci-Fi Epic is ‘The Martian’ Meets ‘The Twilight Zone’
item.description: Andy Weir is known for his dramatic sci-fi survival stories The Martian and Project Hail Mary , which were both adapted into blockbuster films. His latest project combines the same focus on action and ingenuity, but with a more surreal concept that feels straight out of The Twilight Zone . Weir is executive producing Exoplanet , a full-cast audio experience written by Benjamin Percy for Audible. It follows the crew of the starship Wild Blue Yonder as they are scattered across time, landing on the same planet in different eras. The thriller releases on Nov. 5, and Audible provided Polygon with an exclusive clip following Science Officer Logan Bowers (John Leguizamo of The Odyssey ) as he wakes up injured and desperately tries to find help.

item.title: How to unlock the true ending in Phantom Blade Zero
item.description: Phantom Blade Zero 's true ending is called "Final Battle". You can experience four different endings, but this is only one that will connect all the dots, allowing you to gain a better understanding of the story. You will need to complete a list of side quests before reaching the last boss fight if you want to see what the developers consider the perfect ending to Soul's journey.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Unfortunately Borrows Breath of the Wild’s Worst Feature
item.description: The best thing about The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time ’s fantastic new Switch 2 remake is that Nintendo didn’t try to reinvent the wheel. Everything that made the original Nintendo 64 classic special is preserved in a focused game that fights the urge to modernize a timeless experience that still stands on its own today. You won’t find that Hyrule Field has turned into an enormous open world filled with busy work, thank God. You will, unfortunately, find that Breath of the Wild ’s worst feature did manage to creep its way in.

item.title: Constantine Movie Reportedly in the Works at DC Studios
item.description: Francis Galluppi, writer and director of Evil Dead Wrath , has reportedly been brought on board to write a Constantine movie for DC Studios . It is currently unknown whether this film is a sequel to Constantine (2005) or a completely new adaptation of the comic, but the latter seems to be the likely case.

item.title: Everything Is Dissapointing After Pokémon's Spectacular 30th Anniversary TCG Set
item.description: There's nothing wrong with the set. In any other scenario, Delta Reign would be a highlight of a busy TCG release year. Unfortunately, Pokémon's new TCG set is dropping after one of The Pokémon Company's best — if not the best — set releases ever.

item.title: WoW: Forever Had a Very Smooth Launch — Except for Horde PvP Players
item.description: After a rough start for the World of Warcraft: Forever beta due to very high demand , many players expected to see long queues, disconnects, and worse when the game launched in full on Wednesday. But no such problems materialized in what must be one of Blizzard's smoothest game launches yet.

item.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s Changes to the Infamous Water Temple Are Actually Brilliant
item.description: With The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time ’s Switch 2 remake out now, long-time Nintendo fans are in for a lot of warm nostalgia. A trek through the lost woods, duets with Sheik, a return to the Bombchu Bowling Alley — all of those wonderful moments return in a faithful remake that feels every bit as magical as the Nintendo 64 classic. But with all those wonderful moments comes a painful reunion with one of the most hated moments in Zelda history. Yes, you will have to return to the dreaded Water Temple.

item.title: Pokémon Pokopia Celebrates Fall with Apple-Themed Event
item.description: Applin and its Dragon/Grass-type evolutions are coming to Pokémon Pokopia this November thanks to the Apples for Applin event. It's time to start apple-picking so you can trade with Applin and build habitats for all of its friends.
